u2_continuous_a.conditions: Continuous device design point; thermal qualification remains separate

u2_peak_limit_min_a.conditions: High-side peak current limit, full electrical-table conditions

u2_rds_on_ohm.conditions: High-side switch typical only; no maximum across temperature is specified

l1_irms_a.conditions: Typical current producing 40 C rise; includes self-heating in 125 C operating limit

l1_isat_a.conditions: Typical current causing 30% inductance loss; not a guaranteed minimum

u2_frequency_khz.conditions: Typical oscillator; +/-6% typical spread spectrum is not a guaranteed frequency envelope

lm2596_switch_limit_min_a.conditions: Full-temperature minimum switch-current limit used by calculate-power-budget.py (fact-lm2596-current-limit records the 4.5 A typical); see the LM2596 owner bundle

lm2596_vsat_screen_v.conditions: Full-temperature Vsat maximum used by calculate-power-budget.py; fact-lm2596-vsat-max is 1.4 V at 25 C

lm2596_frequency_min_hz.conditions: Minimum oscillator frequency used by calculate-power-budget.py

l23_inductance_min_h.conditions: CYA1265-100UH minimum inductance screen used by calculate-power-budget.py

l23_idc_a.conditions: heat rating current: DC current causing an approximate temperature rise (deltaT) of 40C, TA=25C ambient reference, CYA1265-101M (100uH) row. This is the datasheet's own rated-current metric ('Idc'); it does not separately label an 'Irms' rating, and per its Notes (physical page 4, item 6) the listed rated current is whichever of Isat or Idc is lower.

l23_isat_a.conditions: saturation current: DC current causing L0 to drop approximately 30% from its 0A nominal value, TA=25C ambient reference, CYA1265-101M (100uH) row

l23_dcr_max_mohm.conditions: maximum DC resistance at 25C, CYA1265-101M (100uH) row

d2_if_avg_a.conditions: maximum average forward rectified current at TL (single phase half-wave 60Hz, resistive or inductive load), shared across the SS32-SS3200 family

d2_vf_max_v.conditions: maximum instantaneous forward voltage at 3.0A, TA=25C ambient unless otherwise specified

d3_if_avg_a.conditions: Maximum ratings table: single-phase half-wave60 Hz resistive/inductive load; derate 20% for capacitive load. Does not establish current capability in this PCB thermal environment.

d3_vf_max_v.conditions: Maximum forward drop at IF = 5 A TJ = 25 C, short pulse to minimize self-heating. Catalog0.46 V is typical, not the maximum.

lt1963a_dropout_0a5_v.conditions: Load current 0.5 A; full-temperature marked row. Actual heat dissipation remains a separate limit.

lt1963a_dropout_1a5_v.conditions: Load current 1.5 A; full-temperature marked row. Apply the E-grade temperature qualification in the datasheet notes and the actual thermal operating limits.

lt1963a_ground_1a5_a.conditions: Load current 1.5 A, VIN = VOUT + 1 V. This higher-load table value is a thermal screening assumption for the project 1.2 A load, not an independently specified 1.2 A maximum.

lt3015_dropout_1a5_v.conditions: Load current 1.5 A; full-temperature marked row. Apply the E-grade temperature qualification in the datasheet notes and the actual thermal operating limits.

lt3015_ground_1a5_a.conditions: Load current 1.5 A, measured in dropout. Use 70 mA only as a conservative higher-load thermal screen; the datasheet has no separate 0.8 A maximum. This is not a measurement of operating ground current.

ldo_characterized_max_a.conditions: Highest load at which the retained LT1963A/LT3015 dropout and ground-current maxima exist; no retained number above it

ldo_theta_ja.conditions: LT1963A theta-JA unavailable; LT3015 14 C/W requires 2500 mm2 per side, versus about 293/253 mm2 fitted

tj_screen_c.conditions: Junction ceiling used by calculate-power-budget.py; not a retained LT1963A/LT3015 fact

ptc1_hold_25c_a.conditions: maximum current the device will not trip, 25 degC still air

ptc2_hold_25c_a.conditions: maximum current the device will not trip, 25 degC still air

ptc3_hold_25c_a.conditions: maximum current the device will not trip, 25 degC still air

ptc3_hold_85c_a.conditions: 85 degC ambient hold current (thermal derating), one reflow, conventional one-hour hold

ptc3_r1max_ohm.conditions: maximum device resistance measured 25 degC one hour after tripping or 260C/20s reflow

j10_j11_contact_a.conditions: Per-contact maximum from mirrored family drawing; no independent manufacturer retrieval and no applied-current thermal result. Do not multiply this into a certified 6A connector capability.

j5_contact_a.conditions: AC/DC manufacturer connector rating; installed pair and PCB copper still govern

q1_rds_on_4v5_max.value: 50 mOhm max at VGS=-10 V ID=-4.2 A; 65 mOhm max at -4.5 V/-4 A; 120 mOhm max at -2.5 V/-1 A
